name: API Orchestrator - Reports
description: Generate interactive HTML reports with charts, metrics, health scores and insights from API Orchestrator data.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Reports generates interactive, self-contained HTML reports from API Orchestrator request data. A ReportController offers a configuration page and generate/stream/preview routes; a pipeline of services (ReportDataCollector, ReportHealthCalculator, ReportChartBuilder, ReportHtmlBuilder, ReportStyles/ScriptsProvider, ReportDocumentBuilder, ReportGeneratorService) assembles metrics, health scores, Chart.js visualizations and prose insights into a downloadable document over a selectable date range. Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
